beats.summary: Michael, Dwight, and Jim meet Danny Cordray from Osprey Paper and attempt to make a sale.
Michael offers to sell paper at cost to a client but loses the sale to Danny.

evidence.snippet: Steve: Michael, I'm going with Danny.

beats.summary: Michael and Dwight discuss losing the sale and their frustration with Staples and Osprey Paper.

evidence.snippet: Michael: You know who we always lose out to? Staples, the big guys.

beats.summary: Dwight sets up a secret observation room to spy on Danny's sales techniques.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: What I am about to show you is of the utmost secrecy.

beats.summary: Meredith plays the role of company head to meet with Danny as part of the sting operation.

evidence.snippet: Meredith: Meredith Van Helsing. Pleased to meet you.
Jim: Meredith was the perfect choice to play the head of the company.

beats.summary: Andy and Darryl discuss and critique a song Andy is singing from the point of view of a little girl.

evidence.snippet: Darryl & Andy (singing): Please Mr. President, if you wanna give hope a whirl, bring our troops home safe and sound, says this little girl.
